content.short: Banxa provides fiat on-ramp and off-ramp infrastructure that helps users buy or sell crypto linked to Mantle apps.
content.description: Banxa offers regulated payment infrastructure for turning fiat money into crypto and cashing crypto out through bank transfers, cards, Apple Pay, and local payment methods. Its developer docs emphasize hosted checkout, native API flows, identity and KYC support, and embeddable purchase experiences for wallets, exchanges, and fintech apps. That makes Banxa more of an infrastructure partner than a standalone DeFi product. For Mantle ecosystems, it serves as an access layer that helps users enter or exit onchain positions through compliant purchase and redemption flows.
content.meta: Banxa provides compliant fiat on-ramp and off-ramp infrastructure that helps Mantle apps support crypto purchase and cash-out flows.

resources.title: What Is an On-Ramp Aggregator?
resources.tldr: Press Buy in a wallet and you see several providers quoting one purchase. The named provider runs payment, ID checks and delivery; the wallet only routes.

resources.title: How to Check If a Crypto Platform Is Licensed
resources.tldr: A footer claiming 'licensed' proves nothing. Search the exact legal name from the terms page on the regulator's own register, then check warning lists.

resources.title: Why Crypto Prices Differ Between Platforms
resources.tldr: No venue quotes an authoritative number; each order book settles its own, kept in line by arbitrage. Aggregator sites average them, so quotes never match.
